annotation.authors_or_issuer: Dirección General de Tráfico (DGT), Subdirección General de Gestión de la Movilidad
key_provisions_or_claims: Special DGT authorisation required for testing automation levels 3-5 vehicles on open roads, valid up to 2 years, renewable.
Applicants must hold insurance covering mandatory motor limits plus civil liability for test damage.
Vehicles must be certified by an ENAC-accredited technical service (documentation, inspection, dynamic tests) or hold an equivalent EU member state authorisation.
Designated driver remains responsible and must be able to take full control at any time; override and emergency stop must take priority.
Risk assessment (HARA/FMEA per ISO 26262), cybersecurity, EMC, and software version control are required.
named_instruments_referenced: Real Decreto 2822/1998 Reglamento General de Vehículos
annotation.summary_en: Spanish DGT Instruction 15/V-113 (13 Nov 2015) sets the procedure for special authorisations to test automated vehicles (levels 3-5) on open roads. It defines applicant, vehicle and driver requirements, mandatory insurance, ENAC-accredited certification, and detailed safety, override, braking, lateral-control and cybersecurity tests.
